a.speaker: terra
a.text: Detective, can I ask you something before everyone else weighs in?

b.speaker: terra
b.text: Maybe she’s just taking a break? ...Why is everyone looking at me like that?

back.speaker: terra
back.text: Oh, you’re back. Did anyone say anything useful?

choices.text: What do you think happened to Skye?

theory.speaker: terra
theory.text: I don’t want to say it out loud. ...Okay. What if one of her bytes hatched?

theory2.speaker: terra
theory2.text: In MEGA-BYTES, a byte hatches on your phone. It needs feeding, and rest, and the lights turned down. She’d never leave one alone. She’d stay up all night keeping it warm.

role.speaker: terra
role.text: I check in on people. Somebody should. Mostly it’s asking whether they’re okay and then waiting for the real answer.

end.speaker: terra
end.text: Thank you. Please tell me if you hear anything. Anything at all.
